title: Transfer exact expression parser and qualify functions and published limits
commitMessage: feat: transfer and verify standalone exact expression parser

contribution.summary: Transfer the complete owner-authorized SHA-pinned exact ExpressionParser into a standalone locked dw.quantities.expression package, qualify fractions, rational roots, powers, selection, injected units, temperatures and six public input limits through eleven independent oracles, and prepare adversarial boundary T2.
contribution.value: Delivers a real isolated .NET expression evaluation capability with exact BigInteger arithmetic, typed failures and injectable resolution rather than merely observing or documenting source, while leaving parser hardening and explicit-profile catalogue integration for the next substantive run.
debtChanges: The AURA parser source is transferred byte-for-byte from its RS021 verified snapshot; M1-W02-C02-T2 still must check exponent overflow, adversarial resource use and explicit-profile catalog integration.
The parser takes an explicit injected IExpressionUnitResolver and does not choose host culture itself. An adapter for the qualified standard catalogue is intentionally deferred to T2.
Accepted grammar boundaries are tested at the public Evaluate API, but this does not prove global CPU/memory complexity or external AURA host adoption. M1-W02-C02 remains in progress.
contribution.nextAction: Independently RED-test unsafe parser dimension-exponent arithmetic and strict inherited unit-resolution bridge; fix demonstrated gaps, qualify public adversarial boundaries and close M1-W02-C02 only if all T2 gates pass.

achievements.achievement: The authorized AURA exact ExpressionParser is copied and byte-verified into a locked standalone dw.quantities.expression project with only the dw.quantities dependency; eleven independent direct public-API exact, resolver and budget tests are materialized.

The parser passes fractions, powers, rational/irrational roots, selection functions, injected-unit and temperature algebra oracles, tests public 4096-character, 256-token, depth-32, 256-digit and power/root-16 boundaries, and passes full quantities and foundation regressions.

The exact grammar functional transfer is qualified from the RS021 independent absence RED through pinned binary-identical source installation, separate project compilation and eleven public behavior oracles, with T2 boundary/security integration explicitly open.
